reuse.why: The change reuses getBulkBudgetCategories, averageToBudget, extractTagsFromText, sheet access, budget writes, and the existing undoable method registration.

duplication.why: Category exclusions and amount sign conversion remain shared rather than being repeated in the new action or existing callers.

placement.why: Budget selection and calculation stay in budget/actions.ts, tag parsing uses the shared module, and endpoint registration stays in budget/app.ts.

scope.why: The implementation and tests address the requested budget changes, with only an unrelated import reorder in schedules/app.ts.

maintainability.why: All affected actions use one category policy, with explicit options preserving existing differences and a small new action using established helpers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All affected month-wide actions use getBulkBudgetCategories, and setLastMonthSpending also uses averageToBudget.

disguised_duplication.where: The diff extends the existing shared selection definition without reshaping copied policy logic into individual callers.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories gains fixed-group and saved-template exclusions; includeHiddenCategories replaces the existing includeHidden parameter, and no affected caller bypasses the helper.
